name: surveyor
description: Self-serve Cloudflare-native investigation platform: provisions and runs one anonymous-submission investigation per installation.

scripts.build: npm run build:pdf && npm run build:pdf-worker && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --main-fields=module,main --loader:.sql=text --loader:.txt=text --external:cloudflare:workers --outfile=dist/worker.js --target=es2022 && esbuild src/lib/smoke.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/smoke-lib.js --target=node20
scripts.pretest: npm run build:pdf && npm run build:pdf-worker
